description: Show a swap operation on an array: highlight two elements, swap them, then unhighlight. Uses the GREEN style for variety.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_dsa import MArray, MArrayStyle

class MArraySwapHighlight(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        arr = (
            MArray([5, 3, 8, 1, 9], style=MArrayStyle.GREEN)
            .add_indexes()
            .add_label(Text("Before swap", font_size=24))
        )
        self.play(Create(arr))
        self.wait(0.3)
        self.play(arr[0].animate.highlight(), arr[2].animate.highlight())
        self.wait(0.3)
        self.play(arr.animate.swap(0, 2))
        self.wait(0.3)
        self.play(arr[0].animate.unhighlight(), arr[2].animate.unhighlight())
        self.wait(0.3)
